page.title: Transactions
page.cashTaskLock: Finish or cancel the deposit you’re working on first.
page.importHint: Review and save many transactions from a bank statement PDF.
page.importPrompt: Have a bank statement? Import a PDF to review and save many transactions at once.

timeline.heading: All transactions
timeline.empty: No transactions yet. Add an expense or a deposit to get started.
timeline.malformed: We couldn’t check these transactions, so they’re hidden.
timeline.refreshFailed: We couldn’t refresh your transactions. Showing the ones loaded earlier.
timeline.maybeStale: Your transactions may be out of date. Check the list above before trying again.

filters.invalid: Check your filters. The search is too long, or a date is invalid or out of order.
filters.toggleHint: Stays open while a filter has a problem.

feedback.unknown: We couldn’t confirm the change. Refresh expenses and check them before trying again.
feedback.refreshed: Expenses refreshed. Check them before trying your change again.
feedback.createdRefreshFailed: Expense saved. We couldn’t refresh the list, so refresh it before making another change.
feedback.updatedRefreshFailed: Expense updated. We couldn’t refresh the list, so refresh it before making another change.
feedback.deletedRefreshFailed: Expense deleted. We couldn’t refresh the list, so refresh it before making another change.
feedback.missing: This expense is no longer available. Refresh expenses before making another change.

expenseForm.title: Add expense
expenseForm.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above zero with up to two decimals (maximum 9999999999999999.99).

cashIn.heading: Deposits
cashIn.intro: Money that came into your account, including transfers and refunds. Not counted as income, and not a paycheck unless you link it to a pay schedule.
cashIn.loadError: We couldn’t load your deposits. Refresh them to try again.
cashIn.targetMissing: This deposit is no longer in the current list. Cancel this task to choose another deposit.

delete.heading: Delete deposit: {{description}} ({{date}})?
delete.body: This deletes the deposit and removes it from your reports. If it’s linked to a pay schedule, the link is removed too, but the pay schedule stays.
delete.imported: If this deposit came from an import, importing the same statement again won’t bring it back.

feedback.created: Deposit saved. Reports use its deposit date.
feedback.updated: Deposit updated. Reports use its deposit date.
feedback.deleted: Deposit deleted. Your reports will update.
feedback.createdRefreshFailed: Deposit saved. Reports use its deposit date. We couldn’t refresh the list, so refresh it before making another change.
feedback.updatedRefreshFailed: Deposit updated. Reports use its deposit date. We couldn’t refresh the list, so refresh it before making another change.
feedback.deletedRefreshFailed: Deposit deleted. Your reports will update. We couldn’t refresh the list, so refresh it before making another change.
feedback.validation: We didn’t save the deposit. Check the details and try again.
feedback.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
feedback.forbidden: You don’t have permission to change this deposit.
feedback.missing: This deposit is unavailable. Refresh deposits before making another change.
feedback.unknown: We couldn’t confirm the change. Refresh deposits and check the list before trying again.
feedback.unknownChecked: Deposits refreshed. Check whether your change was saved before you try again.
feedback.refreshed: Deposits refreshed. Check the current deposits before making another change.
feedback.retryAvailable: You checked your deposits. You can try again now; it won’t run automatically.
feedback.blocked: Finish or close the open expense or import task before changing deposits.

fieldErrors.description: Enter a description of 1 to 500 characters.
fieldErrors.amount: Enter an amount above zero with up to two decimals (maximum 9999999999999999.99).

form.title: Add deposit
form.editWarning: Changes also update your reports. If this deposit is linked to a pay schedule, the link stays, its details update, and the pay schedule doesn’t change.
form.amountReviewBody: Enter the exact amount again before saving.
